sources.evidence: Panasonic Energy's current company profile identifies Panasonic Energy Co., Ltd., established in April 2022, as a battery company whose business covers automotive batteries, industrial and consumer batteries, and energy solutions.

Panasonic Cycle Technology's current company profile, current as of February 2026, identifies Panasonic Cycle Technology Co., Ltd. at 13-13 Katayama Cho, Kashiwara City, Osaka and states that its business is the manufacture and sale of bicycles, including electric-assist bicycles and tricycles, electric units, and repair parts.
Bosch's current official corporate accessibility information identifies the operator of bosch.com as Robert Bosch GmbH at Robert-Bosch-Platz 1, 70839 Gerlingen-Schillerhohe, Germany.

Mercedes-Benz Group's current official company profile identifies Mercedes-Benz Group AG, headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany, as the listed parent group for Mercedes-Benz Cars & Vans and Mercedes-Benz Financial Services.

Honda's official October 11, 2024 release identifies Dongfeng Honda Automobile Co., Ltd. as its automobile production and sales joint venture in China, established in July 2003 and located in Wuhan, Hubei Province.
